message:
Since we're going to start enforcing some new policies about black hat activity here I've lumped together all the restrictions onto one help document.  

I've also simplified the rules help doc and even the report reasons.  

In the report reasons I've removed "phishing post", "dumps" and "financial fraud" in favor of one single "Disallowed Blackhat Activity".

If you want to know what activity that is check the help docs.
http://hackforums.net/misc.php?action=help&hid=21

Here are the new rules too.  It's been resorted with some removed and some reworded.

[quote]
1. No flaming fellow members. 
2. No short low quality posts like "bump", "lol", "roflmao", "thanks" and any repeated characters to simple defeat the min character count.
3. Don't attempt to infect members with trojans, viruses, or backdoors.
4. No direct links to infected downloads in posts or profiles.
5. No posting of personal information not yours. Privacy is to be respected here. This includes any passwords, logins or dumps.
6. Signature images can be no larger than 650x200 pixels and 500k size. Animated gifs should not be annoying.
7. You cannot ask for or offer reputation in posts, signatures, or PM. This includes encouragement like "rep is appreciated".
8. No adult images.
9. Multiple accounts will not be allowed unless you are reporting your original account as hacked. Ban evading will result in the permanent closing of your old account and new accounts. No exceptions.
10. Advertising of competing sites is not allowed. This refers to any website with a hacker forum that's similar to HF. Websites without forums or forums unrelated to hacking are acceptable. Advertising includes signatures, PMs, profiles, and posts.
11. No selling of Runescape accounts at HF. Jagex has asked that we do this and I see no reason not to comply.
12. No posting of fake programs.
13. No threads or posts for donation begging.
14. All blackhat hacking activity listed on that linked page is forbidden.[/quote]

At this time there are not actual rule changes.  This is about restructuring and organizing a few things to make them simpler to deal with and scale.  

Those getting warnings for "Blackhat Activity" will also get a PM asking them to read our policy carefully along with a link to our affiliate site if they wish to have those types of discussions. We're going to respect that members want to be part of that activity but we're going to ask that you just take it out the backdoor to another venue.

I'll ask that this thread not become a discussion on HF trying to wear a hat. That's not really what this is about. It's about finding some comfort zone and leading our community toward better quality topics.  We are not a black hat site and we are not a white hat site.  We're a community of hackers.  However certain topics can and will get this site into some legal hot water and if only for that reason alone we have to take measures to reduce that problem.

Thank you.

message:
We are no longer on the Vuwin server.

All CSS and JS content is now being served by CDN's...basically servers across the globe.  I've got 4 accounts actually.

Highwinds
Akamai
AWS S3 (Amazon)
MaxCDN

I'll be adding the images to the setup probably this weekend.  We serve about 500GB a month for images, js, and css.  While that's not really that much for a dedicated the issue becomes DDOS attacks.  By seperating the content to CDNs it become absolutely impossible to DDOS it.  I've made custom modifications to HF so that switching betwen CDNs is one setting.

One issue is that some browsers choke when these things are changed and want to cache the old content.  They might even have problems with external JS but that's rare.  For the most part we've been running external JS/CSS/IMG for months. The only problems have been a few DDOS attacks.  

If you have layout problems please try and close your browser and open it again. If that doesn't work simply delete your cache and restart the browser. That should fix the issue by giving you a fresh version of css/js.

The CDNs serve content from locations across the globe based on your location. So if you live in EU you'll get a server that's a quick hop lowering your latency and making your page speed faster. It's really a good move and it's economical. I may have to get even more creative with this sites content and serving needs by using special APIs to update static content dynamically.  I've only scratched the surface here with what's possible.

This is getting to be some advanced stuff.

message:
This weekend was a majoy increase in our usual traffic with a 20% boost compared to just 2 weeks ago. We are constantly pushing the needs of the server and database as it's now grown to over 2gb in size and we are just about to hit 3 million posts.  Search seems to be one of the top processes that get stuck along with replies/posts.  

I was forced this weekend to face the problem and come up with a solution.  Temporarily I had shut off search for non leet/ub3r members as well as change the flood times for posting, search, and PMs.  This solved the problem but of course was not a permanent fix.  

Possible solutions included a new secondary slave database server. For those that recommended HF has it's own DB server...we already do. It's a good server too.  HF runs on 3 servers in total and a 4th is probably coming. However that solution is time consuming for me and realistically I don't want the added expense nor do I want to be sysadmin on a 4th server.  My time is limited enough now.

A slave DB server would be used for read access only.  It could be setup so that it's a replication/slave mysql server and all reads would be from the new server. I haven't of course tested how much this would help but supposedly according to research this is the next step on large active DB's such as this.

There was also another option available to me.  That was to remove search or alter it significantly.  That's where Sphinx comes into play.  

The Sphinx Search project is an open source full-text search engine.
http://www.sphinxsearch.com/

MyBB's lead developer Ryan Gordon had developed a Sphinx plugin some time ago for NCAABBS.net which he is their sysadmin.  The plugin basically intersect the search page and sends an API call to Sphinx Search. To implement this plugin I only had to install Sphinx on the DB server. I questioned how effective this could be but thought that it was a good time to give it a try.  

Sphinx is marvelous.  Took me less than an hour to install and activate for the site.  Load has dropped tremendously and you may have noticed how quick search results are now. Where they might have taken 3-10 seconds they now pull results in less than 2 second.

I've changed the max results too from 1000 max results to only 300. That should be more than enough for most queries. It's about 15 pages with default 20 results per page.  

The database server is effectively given a new life with Sphinx.  I'd like to thank Ryan Gordon for making this plugin. His continued efforts with MyBB is one main reason I stay with the project for our rather large and active forums. Those that don't believe MyBB can handle a massive forum site they are wrong and HF proves that. 

Thanks everyone and let's hope we have a good week.

message:
I am sick of hearing how the term "hacker" means you're a criminal.  I'd like to start a serious campaign to spread the message that hackers are people that are computer enthusiasts using computers in unorthodox and creative ways.  Hackers are people that think outside the box.  Hackers learn to manipulate code, hardware, and software.  

I think the time has come to undo the damage the media has done to the good name of hackers by slurring the term on the airwaves and damaging reputations everywhere.

Any good website will give multiple meanings for the term hacker.  It was originally not intended to be criminals that use computers to commit crime. But now this is the public perception and it hurts all of us.  I don't see why I can't be a proud hacker and have to hide it amongst friends as if it's something shameful.  

I say we begin a campaign to spread a more truer meaning of the word. One that will allow the media and the public to finally seperate criminality from the meaning.

Here is what I propose.

We start by creating a small website maybe even a single page on a relative domain. I'll see what I have and we can use one of mine.  Next we link all over the internet the keyword "hacker" directly to this page.  The page will have our message.  If we can rank high in the search engine and maybe even overtake Wikipedia imho we will have achieved a victory for all of us and future hackers.  

We need to act.
subject: Taking Back Hacker

message:
Today was a very interesting day for me.  The plan was to meet the new owner, receive final payment, and transfer site.  I was suppose to be contracted to continue operation of HF but under new direction. However the day turned out very differently.  The plan turned out to be unacceptable.

Despite those that believe I don't care about this community because I am selling it you can't be further from the truth.  I have a vested interest in making sure projects I started and sell continue to be a success.  This is after all my reputation at stake.  I didn't spend 3 years building this site up and bonding this community just to have it fall apart.  

While I can't go into direct details about the contract and what the new owner wanted to do. I can say that it was disagreeable to me.  It went against what I stand for and what I believe the vast majority of members would want.  So I told him no.  That's right. The site is not sold.  At least not yet. 

I gave him a new proposal one that I felt was more in tune with this community and also with his goals.  I pointed out previously that he wasn't a forum guru but after meeting him and discussing his ideas I realized that it wasn't going to work the way he believed.  This site would collapse quickly, my contract to run this place would be worthless, and the value he paid for would be gone.  His inexperience was a real problem.

So right now we are back to the drawing board.  While I'd like to say that in a few weeks this will get sorted out it could be months.  I don't know a great deal about the new owner but he seems a busy fellow which his cell phone constantly ringing. Heck it took 6 months just to get to today. So I won't be surprised if another 6 months passes to finish this.  

He is relying on my expertise. I do forsee him making good profit and reaching his end goals if indeed we follow my plan.  Until everything is 100% the goals and plans will remain secret to everyone.  So don't ask.

And this isn't about money either. I am still agreeing upon the same price even though HF has grown and so has income. This is about integrity, reputation, and the longevity of this community.  I won't make any deal that gets this site shut down or dwindle into nothingness. It was tough at one point seeing the money on the table and coming to realize that I wasn't going to get it today.

For those that might believe I should keep the site bear in mind that's not my long-term goal.  Eventually one way or another I will no longer own this website. I have other projects to startup and maintain.  

It was that thread a few days ago that really helped guide my decision today.  Even the new owner was very impressed and many of my arguments to stop his plan was backed up by member sentiment.  

I'll be reopening L33t/Ub3r tomorrow. We'll continue business as usual until these issues are resolved.

Thanks everyone for your support.

message:
With sadness I have some important news to tell you.  As many of you know HF was sold back in September.  The new owner had given me a deposit and was going to take possessions after a few weeks. Weeks then turned into months.  He had delays and I had delays.  Well the time is now coming.  

As of this weekend I will no longer own HF.  Thursday will be a server move to his datacenter. He will be responsible for all server admin duties.  I'll will not have control over firewalls or how the server is run.  Pretty sure I won't have SSH access.

I will remain on for a time as the site admin under a monthly contract.  So I should still be able to assist members, enforce policies, and keep the site current. How long this lasts is anyones guess.

New policies will of course be coming but I regret to inform you that I don't know what they will actually be.  The new owner is going to remain anonymous for some legal reasons. I know very little about him myself other than his money is now in my bank.  It's probably very wise to be anonymous running a site like this. 

I fear some vast changes are going to happen initially.  Based on the few conversations about HF's future I get the feeling he's going to make changes here that will be controversial.  Needless to say I'll fight to make sure this site remains as true to it's nature as possible. When I ask him about changes he really doesn't tell me much.

I don't know the future of the l33t/ub3r group.  He has hinted on ending them but I can't be sure.  Know that even if new memberships to the upgraded groups end that I am making sure current upgraded members remain in their respective groups.  

The feeling I get is that the new owner has some black hat intentions with the site.  Possibly opening up some hidden carding areas or maybe just removing some of the rules I have had in place.  Some of the delays we have had were for legal reasons as his lawyers were reviewing laws and implementations with this site.  At least that's what I was told.

HF earns some decent income.  I know he is buying it to maintain that income.  If he makes mistakes with this site that value will be gone quickly.  So I am advising him to take slow steps.  But once the site is sold it's his to do with as he wishes.  I'll just be an employee.

message:
I am going to start this thread with a timeline of events this past week.

1. On Sunday Sept 27th the site was defaced by a group in Saudi Arabia.  They apparently used RFI in a plugin but this is not confirmed.  This was about 5am PST.  I was up early that day and by 9am the site was up running just fine.

2. Sunday night I spent time doing some server hardening.  The RFI had access it shouldn't and so I made adjustments to prevent future damage.  

3. On Monday morning I woke up to a very nasty defaced page.  Essentially the people that hacked HF on Sunday were being attacked.  They had directly blamed me for encouraging it and threated an "rm -f /" if it was not stopped. For those unfamiliar with that command it's a complete delete of the server. Basically it won't boot and you are forced to reinstall OS.  It's a cluster fuck.

4. I was rather pissed since I had not encouraged any such attacks nor would I.  I actually preach the complete opposite because these type of wars are never going to end pretty. HF is not a group or clan. It's a website I own and manage solely on my own.  I can't control members.  If you deface the front page and place your forum URL people will of course act on their own and attack you.  That's the results of pissing off over 70,000 HF members.  

5. I tried to recover the site and stop the defacement.  Later I learned they had made DNS changes so that's partially why this was such a problem. However it did appear that the attackers had access and control of the site.  

6. To stop further damage to HF and my mental state I turned off the server.  Essentially shutting it down.  I posted this on Twitter.
[quote]HackForums.net is done. I am closing the site and moving on. I am unable to make money from it hence it's not worth keeping. Bye everyone.[/quote]

This was the direct result of my own personal frustration from recent events in my life.  I was not in the mood to work on HF for two days. The server requires a complete rebuild to really be sure it's secure.  I faced a long week ahead of me and at the end of the day I still would be broke.

7. DNS was changed for the site to point to another host with a temporary holding page.

8. That night in IRC I started to recieve a lot of offers to buy the site as well as offers for free hosting.  Given the circumstances it made sense to attempt a sale.  I made a thread on Digitalpoint to offer it for sale.

9. An offer of $35k was made from gh0st.  I normally wouldn't post this information but gh0st had made it very public he was buying the site and for that price.  I told him I would require a $500 deposit the next day via Western Union or Wire Transfer to secure the sale.  I had a lot of offers that night some were very good and from serious buyers.

10. The next day I began to communicate with gh0st.  There was complications with the WU and he said it wouldn't be approved till that evening.  I believed him. Later on as we talked on the phone we had agreed to just go forward with this and he would send the Wire Transfer for the complete amount and we could close the sale. It was 1pm PST and he stated in an hour he would go to the bank.  Two hours later I contact him and he tells me he is actually at the bank.  Another hour goes by and he says they are just sending it now.  More time passes and eventually he tells me that it's after hours and that they will wire it first thing in the morning.  At this point I am very skeptical and begin to contact other bidders. Gh0st still insists he is buying the site but at this time no deposit or payments have been recieved.  

11. I know that HF being down isn't a selling point so I begin to work on it.  A sale is likely given all the offers but delays can be costly to the site.  Within 2 hours of working I have HF turned on. DNS was reverted to the regular server.  For those that are using a proxy to connect you will either have to wait till DNS propogates or alter your windows hosts file.  You can also try a flushdns command from cmd "ipconfig /flushdns".

12. Site resumes operations Friday evening. 

13. Site is once again compromised and I am forced to remove any plugins from the site.  The penetration is severe and I still suspect a backdoor somewhere.  However with all the offers for free hosting and buyers waiting I find it useless to rebuilt what might just be moved in a few days.

14. After some decision making I remove all "hacking" related forums from view.  The content still exists but it's restricted.  I know this may sound weird but there is a good reason for this move.  A potential buyer might have to get funding.  They may have to get approval on a new host.  They might even have to convince an investor.  I am also taking this time to speak with my lawyer about liability in a sale and also my TOS/AUP for the members. For these reasons I find it prudent to make these temporary adjustments.  HF was never intended to become the site is has.  I know many of you enjoy it but I am getting the feeling it's out of control.  If the content being posted is going to place me in legal jeapardy then it's going to be removed.  Too often lately I am seeing dumps and malicious posts.  So for all these reasons I have restricted certain forums.  Know that this change is likely temporary until the site is sold which is going to be in a manner of days.

15. Today is Saturday Oct 3.  I woke up and server is online.  I don't plan to spend the weekend answering questions about "why, what if, or who". I am likely to just delete PMs I get.  You can hop in irc://irc.malvager.com/hackforums where I will probably idle so serious buyers can contact me.


Now you are up to date.  I'll add that avatars are disabled. All plugins are disabled. HFl33t access is disabled. I reiterate...these are likely to all be temporary. Maybe up to a week but I am hoping less time than that. I have a buyer who is contacting me Monday after a long convo Friday. He seems to show the most promise but there are other buyers as well.

I really don't want to hear complaints about this being the end or how HF now sucks.  If you feel that way you're certainly welcome to leave.  Most of these problems are very recent and given the 2 1/2 year history I don't think a week of fluctuation is going to destroy a great site like this. We have haters but we have always had them.  Don't let the haters convince you to hate too.  We are still a strong community granted with restricted topics but we can still communicate.  You still have access to your PM boxes as well. All I ask is that members show some patience. 

Thank you.

message:
We are now running HF officially on 3 seperate server.

1. Firewall, Apache, MTA
2. Image Server
3. MySQL Server

At this point...DDOS attacks will pretty much be over.  I am sure a few adjustments will need to be made but overall.  This setup is going to bounce off almost all attacks.  

The old load on the server was about 1.5-3.  Mysql accounted for at least 40-50% of that load.  With it's removal the main server load is now at .35.  A vast reduction. Mind you this is a quad-core server so a load of 4 is 100%.  

New setup allows the apache server a LOT of resources it previously did not have.  Threading will be much better.

We can easily double in growth now.  I am going to expect the old problems with kernel panics and Mysql max connections are now over.  At most I have to do some tweaks but I am positive this is a long-term solution to the problems we have faced all summer.  

Thank you.

message:
I have the old HF server still up and running. I have a few sites on it but nothing major. It's not powerful enough to run HF and it's at another datacenter so it's not exactly very useful to us...or so I thought. This morning I realized it would make a perfect image server.  It's mostly setup already since it was the old HF server.  So I made the proper DNS changes and img.hackforums.net is setup.  Do a view of the sites source code and you'll see most images are now called from there. I had to make some adjustments to MyBB to accomplish this but OMG is there a big difference now.  Bandwidth on the server is now cut in 1/2 and so is load.  

One of the major differences though will be the firewall problems we constantly have.  Many are making too many connections from their browser but this is partially because of the many images that are loaded.  A browser may see 80 images in a thread and try to create 20+ connections.  Now you load a few pages and maybe do some refreshing and BINGO...you're IP banned in the firewall.  However I couldn't turn it off as we under an almost constant DDOS attack from someone.

So this is a major change. I haven't even completed setting up the MySQL dedicated server yet but when I do expect HF to be absolutely amazing and the downtime should all but disappear.  Having a dedicated image server saves the main server a lot of hassle. No more logging or opening up httpd connections just to serve images.  

What's not moved is attachments and avatars.  I still have to move smilies but I gotta dig into the MyBB code to make the adjustment.  I'll get it done though.  

So enjoy the new speed and hopefully less trouble. I'll flush the firewall too. 

Thanks.

message:
Enough is enough.  I am purchasing our second server now which is about 30% more powerful and has twice the ram.  It's beefy and I am going to be running BOTH servers.  One will be front end Apache and the other as mysql.  I might even replace Apache with litespeed or nginx.  Something to handle the output of images and static content.

This could take me a week or two to setup this all up correctly as I want to test many things and to be honest I haven't run dual servers before. I did run 3 servers at one point but they had independent sites on each.  This is going to be a master/slave which is a bit more complex.  

I just added $200 to my monthly server costs too. I can't say I am very happy. I am at $400 a month to run just this one site. But the downtime lately has been so atrocious that I fear not doing it too. 

I have Apache running very well imho but MySQL craps out a few times per day now.  If I give MySQL more resources (connections) it kernel panics the server.  Most of our downtime is from small attacks now that are on top of our already high traffic.

This server is going to be setup completely different than my previous servers. There will be no control panel, apache, or MTA.  It will mainly have one purpose and that's MYSQL with our 1.1GB database that is growing rapidly.  

If things continue this way I will need a third server as a firewall/load balancer possibly.  Where the whole server is one giant packet filter.  This assumes that attacks may intensify.  Instead of buying a Cisco firewall I would just use FreeBSD firewall. I believe I can control 250,000 packets per second from a dedicated system.  That's a lot more than most low-end cisco firewalls.  The server doesn't even have to be very high-end to produce those results.  

I am half exited and half shitting bricks right now.  This is going to be an undertaking and I pretty much have to do everything on my own.  Here's hoping it goes well and no problems arise.

message:
Events of today in PST.

9:30am - Server goes offline.

11:15am -  I wake up. Server offline for a still undertermined reason.

11:30am - Reboot shows problems with /var partition.  FSCK probably required.

12:00pm - Server dying on all attempts to run httpd.  It's locking up and processes appear stuck. 

1:00pm - After doing all I could without a KVM I pay datacenter $75 for a monthly KVM hookup.  

1:45pm - KVM finally hooked up.  However they didn't hookup keyboard correctly.

2:00pm - KVM now properly hooked up

2:15pm - My wife calls. Car is broken down and I have to drive down to help her.

4:30pm - I arrive home. Car is in the shop. Luckily fix and tow will be free as this was a previous problem still under warranty.

4:50pm - HF is back.  Took me only a few short minutes to get everything back.

So today is suck.  As you can tell most of the problem was just having the time.  I still don't know WTF locked up. No kernel panic this time and imho this just might have been a read/write error on the drive and it needed an FSCK.  It's hard to determine. I just hope that I am not going to be facing a drive failure.  Sometimes the datacenter runs specials on additional drives and if that happens I might run gmirror which is a software raid system for freebsd. My only concern is performance though.

btw..anyone following our twitter would have been updated to any problems.

http://www.twitter.com/hackforumsnet

message:
Well I spent the last 24 hours working to get the bugs worked out of the system that have caused the kernel panic, sql connection errors and giving us downtime.  I have updated more software, made a ton of tweak, and I think I have it all locked in now.  

If all goes well the next week then I can assume the server is back to running at tip top shape. Since our traffic continues to grow and I make adjustments for certain attacks sometimes a couple small changes can build up some detrimental effects.  Apparently I was giving MySQL too many resources and over time it was using as much as 20GB of space when small attacks occurred.  Even though the attacks were small my configuration created a larger problem.  

Settings should be great now and I have even gone ahead and updated a couple important packages to the latest versions.  I have basically spent the past day watching SSH and making minor adjustments to see effects.  

So here's hoping that this week is better than the last.  I might even be able to get some work done.  There is still so much I want to accomplish for this site.

Thanks.

message:
A DDOS attack started a few hours ago. It's nothing extraordinary but with our natural traffic so high it's harder to firewall at times.

I tried to create some good rulesets but it seems like httpd kept gumming up when it had about 1000 processes. So it kept making me restart it over and over.  I am not sure how many IPs are involved but probably a couple thousand at least.  

Right now I have simply altered httpd so that only whitelisted countries can view HF.  That includes US, UK, CA, AU, IN and JP.  If you are not in one of those countries you may just have to wait for DDOS to end.  I should probably go with a whitelist only setup anyways.  

I'll try and keep everyone posted but if we go down I'll update our twitter.

Looks like after some investigating options where I weight costs, setup, and upkeep I have concluded I will be getting a second server for HF.  Not a replacement. HF will be running on 2 servers.  I haven't locked down the exact config yet but it's likely one will be for database and the other for everything else. I may also get a third cheaper setup strictly for a firewall and load balancing. After looking into options this is what I have come up with.  

I haven't run multiple systems linked before but it shouldn't be too hard.  Bascially HF will have it's own farm of servers soon enough.  I wasn't expecting this for months but recently just natural traffic and activity has exploded.  We have literally doubled in just 4 months and I expect us to double again in 4 more months. Already we went from 6000 posts per day a month ago to 9000 posts yesterday. That's insanity.  

The good news is that donations and HF l33t memberships are up enough to pay for second server.  Also good news is that HF will be harder to take down if indeed we run multiple servers.  

I look forward to the day when I have a 1/4 rack somewhere.

message:
Today this was posted at Full Disclosure.

[quote]Dear Jesse Labrocca (Omniscient) and Hackforums.net, 

The Anti-Sec movement has officially terminated Blackhat-forums.com using yet ANOTHER 0-day exploit that we have discovered. This one takes advantage of a previously undisclosed LiteSpeed vulnerability. This is primarily to prove that we are serious and committed to our primary goal - eradicating full-disclosure of computer vulnerabilities and exploits, and terminating general discussion of hacking for any n00b and script-kiddie to read and review - and learn from. 

The Anti-Sec movement hopes Hackrforums.net now understands that our cyberwar against you is NOT a joke. We will be terminating Hackforums.net. You are our number one target...we want to savor the moment and the suspense. We will strike when you least expect it. This we promise.[/quote]

It's reminiscient of their original threat.  However BHF wasn't named orginally. HF was considered their #1 target.  Why isn't HF down then?

Then a few hours ago a couple credible members in the hacker community came forward to denounce that this was indeed Anti-Sec.  I tend to believe them for a number of reasons.  I won't disclose private information exchanged but I do find it unlikely we are at this time threatened by Anti-Sec.  It's possible but unlikely.

Then this was posted...

[quote]Yes, that's right, we're not really Anti-Sec. 
We have no 0-day exploits. 

We did not hack ImageShack or Blackhat-forums or Astalavista. That was the real Anti-Sec whomever they are. 

It was all a big joke. 

But our goal was achieved. 

We caused a huge stir on Hackforums.net. We've made them look like utter fools. 

Geez, some of them are like "Let's go to the authorities! Mummy and Daddy I wanna go to authorities because my hacking forum has been threatened." What a bunch of wimps. You're on a hacking website. You've gotta expect these things. It's all part of the deal. 

We've proved one thing...none of you on Hackforums.net should be there...not even Jesse Labrocca. He should spend more time with his family rather then worry about a silly little hacking forum. Or maybe spend more time on your money-making business. Silly person. 

Sincerely, 

Anonymous People[/quote]

Now what are we to believe?  

Anyone can clearly see that on the actual Anti-Sec site this is their philosophy.

[quote]Blend in. 
Get trusted. 
Trust no one. 
Own everyone. 
Disclose nothing. 
Destroy everything. 
Take back the scene. 
Never sell out, never surrender. 
Get in as anonymous, Leave with no trace.[/quote]

Reading that can make your head spin if you try to apply it to this situation.  Are they lying to us?  Who knows?  

One thing for sure...we are still up and running. Within a few minutes of that second threat HF was under another very heavy DDOS attack.  However it didn't even slow us down.  It went on for about an hour till it was shut off.  The attacker now knows his attacks are fruitless.  It's still going on but it's completely mitigated.  I expect maybe tomorrow it will completely stop.  


Now some will begin a lot of speculating about the above messages, who to trust, and what we should be doing about it. 

1. We trust no one.  It's part of Anti-Sec's mission statement but it's a good philosophy for any hacker.
2. It doesn't matter any speculating we do.  It changes NOTHING about how HF operates and my own philosophy.  
3. We will do nothing about it.  That's my policy and always has been.  I only hope the FBI looks deep into this case and can find some evidence to arrest and convict anyone that does commit a criminal act with their computer.  The DDOS attacks on HF were real.  The attack on Imageshack was real.  HF is however not an investigative legal body.  We are only a victim.

I want to also address some ridicule toward me personally and our community about this "joke".  They state their goal was achieved. I highly doubt that.  HF membership has skyrocketed and so has donations.  We are probably more popular now than ever before.  Was this the goal they set out to achieve?  If they believed I would be "scared" they were wrong.  I was mindful and respectful of the real possibility that Anti-Sec would actually attack.  If indeed this was a joke it was a believable one.  I am called a "silly person"...hmmm...that's funny for a guy that spends his day DDOS attacking sites and making joke threats. If indeed this was a joke he took the time to make elaborate logs too. Pretty pathetic in my view.  

We are told we look like "utter fools".  I don't see it that way.  I think we responded fairly well.  

Now comes a very serious question. If indeed this was a hoax then why expose it now?  Why not just leave the threat open and let us speculate forever.  Instead you voluntarily come forward to say..."hey just kidding".  I ain't buying it.  Something has scared you.  Could it be the real Anti-Sec doesn't like it's name being used by script kiddies with a stupid agenda?  Could it be that you found out HF was more secure than you thought and have decided since you can't hack it you'll call it a joke as you slowly go hide into obscurity.  Or could it be indeed the threats were the real Anti-Sec and are attempting to trick us into lowering our guard.  Could it be that Anti-Sec didn't expect the negative response they recieved from the community?  Seemingly some members started to attack Anti-Sec server without my approval or knowledge of course.  Could that have invoked that response?

The mission statement of Anti-Sec gives us clues.  So do the messages at Full-D.  I find it hard to fathom that the rantings at Full-D are the same as the intelligent well-worded messages at Anti-Sec.  

In any case HF goes on.  We grew and learned from this whole experience. 

What has transpired the past week has been exceptional and unpredictable.  The drama was titillating and very exciting. It's wrought with inrigued and speculation. We may never know the truth.  Isn't that always the best part of a great story?

I am hoping this is the last thread related to this saga. Please do not start any new threads related to Anti-Sec.  Instead post in the active thread that currently exists.

Thank you.
subject: Anti-Sec Threat Labeled a Joke

message:
Some have come forward with convincing evidence and arguments that the recent threats made toward HF and Milw0rm are not the work of Anti-Sec.  It's likely that whoever is behind the DDOS attack that has been prevalent the past 5 days (yes it's still going) may be behind the false post on Full Disclosure.  

I tend to believe this to be true.  

Also coming forth is that some members apparently are attacking the romeo.copyandpaste.info site.  I am asking that any attacks please cease.  They are not helpful to HF at all.  You will only anger people.  People that might in fact be completely innocent in this dramatic fiasco.

Anti-Sec has taken credit for the ImageShack penetration. There is no basis to believe they wouldn't take credit for attacking HF or for creating a future threat.  You could theorize that it's a ploy but I refuse to take the attitude that "everyone is out to get me". I am already vigilant with my security as any good sysadmin should be.  

I have always stated that the who or why someome attacks HF is of very little importance.  What's important is our community and it's resolve to stay running.  

I do not want any attacks on any sites.  If you want to help HF you can simply participate in the forums and show your support vocally.  No need to attack anyone. 

Thank you and I hope this resolves some issues.
subject: Anti-Sec Latest Developments

message:
HF was officially named by Anti-Sec Movement as being their #1 target.  

http://seclists.org/fulldisclosure/2009/Jul/0168.html

They don't take credit for this DDOS attack but I can't be sure it's not them and imho I suspect it is.  Always hard to say.

My official response to them is that HF will not be terminated.  They can only temporarily shut us down via DDOS or exploit. Even a complete root of the server and "rm -R /" won't stop us.  Anti-Sec wants to believe it's a force to be reckoned with.  My response is so are we.  If they want to paint a target on sites like HF and milw0rm they are going to make a lot of enemies.  The hacker community at large will not idly sit by and allow one group to terrorize us with bullshit hacktivism.  

The ideals of Anti-Sec are twisted. Their logic is that full-disclosure is evil.  Yet the exploit used against ImageShack is reportedly a disclosed exploit.  They claim that scare-tactics are used by the security industry to make money.  HF doesn't make any money off scare tactics though.  And right now it's Anti-Sec using scare tactics to achieve their goals.  It's hypocritical.

I have been asked by many members if they can have permission to retaliate.  My stance has always been that illegal retaliation in the form of attacks is wrong.  I stand by that.  However there is imho a few things we can do and I hope members make this their mission.

1) Penetrate the Anti-Sec
2) Release publically their identities
3) Hunt down their supposed zero-day exploits and publish them so security experts can patch them

#3 is particularly awesome as it's exactly what they are fighting against.  They themselves have created a reason why publishing exploits is important for the security industry.  

I believe their logic is that if you get rid of script kiddies you get rid of hackers.  This is like saying if you get rid of book authors you get rid of books.  It's impossible. You will always find someone wanting to gain knowledge and someone else willing to teach it.  That's actually the basis of civilization.  What we learn we share.  It's part of the principle I think we all believe in at HF.  Whether you call it "freedom of speech" or just plain "sharing of knowledge" it's just as vital as breathing.  

I am unsure if my post will be read my Anti-Sec. Or if they do read it how they will respond.  My direct statement to them is that any attack you ensue on HF ultimately will fail. You have your resolve and I have mine.  However I have one big thing going for me.  That's a huge and supportive community. I also have the law on my side.  If you attack or penetrate you have committed an illegal act.  Anti-Sec is no better than common criminals.   

Lastly in many ways I want to thank Anti-Sec for promoting HF.  Your statement at seclist.org will surely make news everywhere drawing more attention to HF.  Heck donations might just poor in so I can upgrade my hardware which will help HF grow even more.  Your efforts are basically helping me.  Thank you for that.

I also want to thank all HF members and supporters. The past week has been a roller coaster ride but it's been very enlightening.  I am sure this isn't over but I am sure we will win.  

Thank you.
subject: Response to Anti-Sec Movement

subject: Clever...

message:
Well on Monday May 23rd around 1:30 PST a massive DDOS attack was launched against HF.  I was on the site at the time and was rather stunned to see my server load hit 450. Yes...450!  I was rather astonished and taken aback.  I made all my basic moves against the attack but wave after wave of IPs were nailing the server.  The attack was basic but it was massive.  The attack involved well over 3000 drones from a botnet.  I am sure it's a botnet because nearly all the IPs I checked were from home connecting ISP's.  I worked about two maybe three hours trying different methods but I must confess.  I was wore down eventually and decided to ride it out.  I had unfortunately for HF members some existing plans for the weekend. They included going to UFC98, which was awesome, and spending some time with the wife.  I had simply firewalled all port 80 traffic to save the server from being farked.  

I check the server again last night while I was out on my mobile. The attack was still going on somewhere around midnight.  I didn't have time last night to deal with it further so I got some sleep.  

This morning I missed HF so badly I woke very early and took a peek.  Well the attack is still going on but it's not as strong.  In the three hours I took yesterday I added a couple more goodies for server protection that are now implemented.  They seem to be helping.  Load is now around two which is fine...average for HF is 1.5 - 2.5 (quad core).  This image shows the last 24 hours.  You can see the spikes where the full force of the attack hits.  Even between the spikes the attack was persistent and the IPs attacked were rolled out about 100 per 10-15 minutes.  I was at a point where I was banning every IP that hit the server hoping to snag them all but after 2000 I realized this could just keep going.  

[img]http://image-host.com/images/eenmwfdm8zwti551hn8e.jpg[/img]

If you are forced to use a proxy to see the site send me a PM with your normal IP to check the firewall. Until I am sure the attack is over we are under red alert and all aspects of the server are at a high state of security. Currently the site is only viewable for logged in members. Everyone is also throttled so the site might appear slow.[b] I am geo blocking most of the world and only whitelisting a handful of countries to begin with (USA, GB, AU, UK, IN, and CA). If you not in one of these regions please be patient. HF will return to normal asap.  [/b]

So far no one has taken credit for the attack.  This is only significant attack on the new server which has taken us down.  It says a lot imho about both the server and the attacker. While I am not happy we are DDOS'd I will congratulate the attacker on their success.  Whoever you are and for whatever reason you did attack I don't know but congrats.  You successfully took us down something many script kiddies only have wet dreams about.  

While this is the largest attack on the site it's not the worst.  Mulcinder gets that credit imho for reeking havoc on the old server last year with his shell script uploaded to a vulnerable site that was on my server.  I had many hours of work on that one. This one is basic DDOS attack.  

I want to once again state my very clear and open policy on attackers...HF is not a group or a clan. It's forum run and owned by me.  I don't attack anyone nor do I condone attacks.  I am 100% against anyone seeking retribution against these attackers. I take that policy very seriously.  It's not helpful to get into a war.  We were DDOS attacked, taken down, and now we're back up.  Other than discussing what happened that's the end of it.  Most attacks don't even warrant attention but of course a 19 hour downtime is significant for us.  

If we go down again which I am sort of expecting please just be patient. I ask that you don't run any auto pingers or sit and refresh like a maniac hoping to get a page load. A reasonable checking period would be once every 15 minutes. My server drops all ICMP packets so don't bother with them.

This is Memorial Day weekend so I am hoping that many of you took the down time to go outside and enjoy the day.  Go to the park, see a movie, hang with friends or whatnot.  HF will never be taken down forever.  We might be DDOS'd or HACKED but I won't be going out of business.  HF is here to stay so don't worry.  

Enjoy and feel free to discuss.

message:
If you are having slowdown on the site or sometimes for 5-10 minutes pages don't load it's likely that my firewall has blocked you temporarily.  What causes this? Well the firewall is triggered by multiple connections from a single source.  I alter the setting from time to time but let's give it an average of 10.  Sometimes it's relaxed and could be as high as 40 and sometimes it's strict (during DDOS attack) to 3.  

But what if this is happening to you all the time even when HF isn't under attack?  Well it could be your browser and most likely you are on Firefox and possibly using some plugin to speed up your connection. In truth it's just creating more simultaneous connections.  

So what do you do to fix it?  

Easy...open up Firefox in the URL type "about:config" and then in the filter area type "connections" and you should get four settings.  

Lower the "network.http.max-connections-per-server".  I would say 10-12 is a safe for average users.  Will this slow you down?  Probably not. Realistically lots of servers have a max connection per ip to stop DDOS attacks. In truth you might browse faster.  

Many servers use persistent connections (including mine) but those connections can be closed for a variety of reasons.  One of which of course is your browser.  

So view the attached image and if you have questions please ask.

message:
It's not a secret that HF was penetrated by a group 2 days ago.  The entry was from a site on my server which shares the same hosting account.  I have security measures to prevent spreading of exploits to the server and other accounts but unfortunately I did have HF on the same hosting account as many other sites.  That is going to be fixed.

The entry was relatively simple.  They found a site on the account which was an old image hosting script which I had purchased long ago.  Too long.  The script was easily exploitable.  The attackers wisely uploaded a shell script and had their way with a number of sites on the server.

I was up late the night before at a rather fun Christmas party and slightly hung over but rather tired. My plan was to watch football all day and chill out. I have a couple fantasy teams one of which is a paid league where I was in the playoffs. I had a change to win some big money so watching the games was important to me.  The wife also had the day off so we were hoping to spend time together.

I was informed very early.  Someone had called me within 15 minutes of me waking up saying that HF was pwnd.  Not exact words but close enough.  My reaction was "awe shit not today". Upon bootup and logging in I can see sure enough....HF was pwnd.  

So I start my work.  Checking logs, viewing the penetration, and I found the entry point pretty quick.  However they had backdoors everywhere and more shells being added and spawning themselves.  It's a big server and lots of sites.  I had gained control of HF but not for long with all these shells. I did this for maybe 45 minutes to an hour until I saw some things that gave me the impression I was rooted.  There was some scripts that were rather nasty and I could see some alterations to a few binaries.  That's a sure fire sign of a full r00t breach. So I shut down.  Turned the server completely off.  

My NOC is great. I colo my server and been there over 5 years.  They know me. They do favors and not charge me.  They gave me a KVM hookup. For those that don't know what that is...it's a direct connection to server over an IP address which is the exact same as having a console and keyboard.  It's pseudo remote control.  So from here I needed to start accessing damage and performing backups.  This took hours and well...was stressful.  I wanted to watch football. 

At the same time I had been discussion the entry with the leader of the group that entered.  They appear to be some teenagers with no particular agenda beyond showing off their skills.  I had a lengthy discussion with him.  Seems like a nice kid.  He was concerned about the spam and DOS attacks he believed some HF members were doing on his forum which btw is rather small and insignificant.  Judging by their forums they aren't very big and the penetration of HF could be their biggest triumph. It garnered them a lot of attention which is probably why HF is such a big target.  

To quell his concerns I posted a message about my policy of seeking revenge or retribution.  My policy still stands that HF is not a clan or crew and any actions the members here commit are unrelated to this website. I ask that no action be taken using the HF name.  And I see no reason to attack them or their site.  I can't control what members here do but I can ask that if you do respect HF or I that you don't use HF as an excuse to attack other sites.  If you suck HF into a war I can guarantee HF will lose and that's because I surrender and won't retaliate so please....don't drag me into your hacker wars.  You just create more work for me.  

So now server is offline, HF and a couple other sites were moved to backup hosts and I was working on getting complete local backups. I have backups but I wanted 100% complete filesystem backs.  It was more than 5GBs so it took a long ass time...about 3 hours.  

Now I just mentioned my backup hosts. Some may already know but one of them is Dreamhost.  They are cheap and I haven't experienced any real problems there.  But guess what...I had a site there penetrated too.  Not the first time at Dreamhost and that's because over the years I have bought and sold some small sites that often run outdated or poorly written scripts. Normally no one gives a shit except maybe spammers that like to use the exploits to place their own ad code.  But HF attracts hackers that like to pwn and brag.  So HF gets ripped a new asshole and then my backup account gets hosed too.  I found the exploit there and took the site down then patched the sites I needed up.  

I began moving a few sites to the backup hosts.  One is a client but I also redirect HF just so it would resolve and I placed up a holder page with a message I would change every few hours with an update.  Now here is the shit kicker:
http://www.dreamhoststatus.com/2008/12/14/spacey-filer-problems/

Dreamhost was having problems and I was effected by it.  What a fucking day right?  

One of my clients who has been with me for years and is a personal friend needed his site up. It's a retail site and well...it is the Christmas season.  So he was a high priority. He is understanding but certainly so am I.  I moved him to Dreamhost but of course DH was having serious problems.  So after hours of it not getting fixed I had to move him to my other backup hosts Servage which btw sucks and I am dropping once my billing cycle is done.  HF originally was on Servage btw.  Somewhere very late at night I finally had him resolved.

9:00pm...I had not eaten yet. I had barely stopped to piss or drink anything.  I peeked at my fantasy football and was getting my ass kicked. So badly that it was apparent by this time that I had zero chance of winning.  What started off as a bad day had no silver lining and ended bad too.  Somewhere around midnight I decided to pop some pills and get some sleep.  I would wake up early and deal with everything then.  At that hour and with my eyes bloodshot I wasn't going to complete the work anyways.

I slept like a rock.

After waking, eating breakfast and clearing my head I took another fresh look.  I had my complete backups.  I had control of server. I believed I had cleansed the files.  I had my KVM and the ISP had setup a new install CD for me ready to redo my entire server.  I weighed my options carefully and with a clear head.   So far I had only moved a couple key sites but the nuts and bolts were still on my server waiting for my next action.  I could have reinstalled but decided to do more checking on what happened.  Upon more investigation...it appeared I wasn't rooted after all.  I could still be wrong but it looks like the measures I had in place stopped a full-blown security breakdown.  

At this point I made the decision.  I was going to update my FreeBSD and reinstall all binaries.  Is that the smartest move? No it's not.  It's the quickest though. It's dirty and it's unreliable and probably stupid of me to even tell you that.  But if anything I am truthful and well...if they still have backdoors then they do and I will then reinstall everything from scratch.  I have so much custom shit on my server that I don't want to take the time this week when I have Christmas shopping and other personal matters to take care of.  Just bad timing really.    

I was considering also renting a dedicated which would be the fastest method of getting a server online but hey...call me cheap I really didn't want to go that route.  If site does go down I may quickly get a rental and just get us up asap.

So yesterday I did the rebuild work which was more of a patching really.  I upgraded everything and even rebuilt the kernel.  I double checked and triple checked.  By the afternoon I had all my sites back up except for HF.  I know that HF needs a lot of attention and answers so I wanted to make sure if HF went up it stayed up.  All files were checked and I did my best.  I can only hope it was enough.

For the record Mybb was never hacked. I still don't believe we were r00ted.  The penetration was based on a simple one.  The hackers that did this have my respect as they did overall a good job.  I had agreed with them not to retaliate and to ask my members to chill out in exchange for them moving on.  A war doesn't help anyone.  I got lazy, they penetrated, and was hacked.  End of story as that's concerned.

I don't want to mention the group for two reasons.  One they are a competing forums (though it's very small) and two I don't want to encourage retaliation at all.  Their group name is now in the censor list btw.  

Attachments are now restricted to images and text only.  This was something I was planning anyways and I purged the attachments today completely...even images.  This is for security and legal reasons as well as protecting HF members from virus and trojans.  Eventually a downloads section will be made again where legal tools will be added. Preferrably original ones created by HF members.

I won't pretend the past 48 hours didn't suck but I know this comes with the territory.  A lot of nasty things have been said about me and most are from people that have an agenda.  HF isn't liked very well in the hacker community.  Most of you are considered n00bs.  The fact remains that HF is still here and we aren't going anywhere. HF is not a group or clan. HF is a website I own, run, and maintain. The members here are people that like this community, share information, and enjoy the site.  It's pretty simple and straightforward imho.

I hope the drama of this incident dies quickly and we just move on.  

As a side effect some are reporting they can't access HF without a proxy.  This could be that your DNS hasn't updated or it is possible my firewall has you blocked.  Your best bet is to PM me your IP to check that.  If you are not getting a banned message from HF then you are not manually banned.  

As a precautionary measure I suggest you change your passwords.  Keep in mind the database may have been compromised.  Passwords are salted and hashed so it would be extremely difficult (very very) to actually obtain them. However I know that if they got DB they also have PM tables.  What you say in private messages might be compromised. And while I doubt anyone is going to bother reading 70,000 PMs they might do scans for terms like "password" or "username" to see if people give that info up.  I may think of a method to obfuscate PMs so that simple scanning of the tables would be more difficult. It's an idea.

I know some of you are angry over the penetration and some may leave.  That's understandable and hey...I am sorry.  I do my best and I make no claims of being 100% impenetrable.  Some call me cocky but not sure why...I have always stated that I been rooted and hacked plenty of times and that eventually HF would go down. It's the nature of things. It's unavoidable imho just because of the nature of this site.  Many have shown great support though for the site and for me. It's truly appreciated and it helps me cope with all this crap.  I do this for a living but I wouldn't do this if I didn't enjoy it for the most part.  HF is not my biggest earning site yet I spend 90% of my time here working on things.  That will continue for as long as I can see.  I want to see how far HF can go.  Others just want us to fail.  IMHO that's immaturity and jealousy.  I won't let either of those effect me or how this site is run.

Feel free to discuss but I ask that you maintain a level of maturity and respect.  I will delete posts that are meant to be incindiary or are outright nasty.  Criticize if you want but keep respect in mind.  It's been a rough couple days for me and I don't need anymore shit talking.

Thank you for your support.

I am getting too many reports from members about advertising rule breakers.  First of all..I have no rule against advertising. At least not officially.  My policy is that I don't allow advertising of competing forums.  I define a competing forum as one where there is overlap in categories of genre...excluding the obvious (off topic, intro, site news).  So basically other hacker related forums.  That doesn't mean blogs or sites either...specifically it's forums.

Do I care about signature link advertising? Not really.  I allow referral links.  I have nofollow tag in all signature links to avoid SERP penalties.  I prefer someone add a signature for a bux.to referral than constantly creating new posts to get referrals.  

I will tighten up the rules as I see problems but right now the problem is members misinterpreting the rules I have.  

So don't run amuck reporting or giving neg rep to anyone with a link somewhere else.  Yeah...if you see an idiotic new member cross-posting their ad...they are going to get banned.  Low quality is still going to get someone booted.  But don't spaz out on every new link you see.

message:
Consider the recent furor over a member having their account acquired by another member through nefarious means I am forced to create a thread to discuss the matter.

First off...I don't approve of members hacking each other. That said it's not my responsibility to secure a members password, their internet connection, or other methods they may get hacked outside the scope of HF.  

The members in question are Starwiz (the victim) and YCK (the hacker).  I was contacted by Starwiz a couple days ago telling me how his account was hacked by YCK. He gave him his password and YCK has now changed the email and password.  For argument sake lets say he did do this.  I have no proof nor have I bothered to find any. I just assume it's true.

Most are aware the major problem caused at this site where a months worth of posts were lost because of Starwiz and his stupidity of allowing TRH to have his password where they proceeded to destroy thread after thread.  I am over that. I fixed the site as best I can and moved on. My concern is running this site not vendetta's or revenge.  I have better things to do.  Starwiz was banned though for his participation along with some others.

Recently I cleaned the ban list and allowed people to come back.  I have no problem there either.  Starwiz was unbanned and returned. Seemingly has been a good member.  

I want to relay also that before all this drama Starwiz at some point "lost" his password and was unable to login. Apparently he wasn't aware that he could use the "forgotten password" feature and annoyed me repeatedly until he pulled his head out of his ass to fix it.  I hate being annoyed by other peoples problems when they have the ability to fix it themselves.  A pet peeve of mine...I don't like my time wasted.

So back to the present.  Once Starwiz PM'ed me his drama I quickly replied he has to deal with it and it's really not my problem. And guess what...it's NOT.  I didn't tell YCK to hack him. I didn't tell Starwiz it's OK to give out his password which btw is an incredibly asinine stupid thing to do. I can't express enough how stupid that really was.  And no one should disagree about that. Trusted member or not...there isn't ANY reason he needed his password here. He was already HF l33t.  

YCK is a good member. I read his reasoning for doing this.  I think it's ironic and well...funny actually.  What has Starwiz lost?  Well...he has lost his account.  I don't trust YCK anymore or less than I trust anyone else here.  Which is ZERO.  He has no special access to the site.  He has been helpful in finding exploits and while he does use those exploits he hadn't done any damage here.  So I can respect that and I respect him.  Respect does not equal trust.  I don't know YCK...I have no idea who he is nor do I really care.  He is a notable member one of hundreds here.  

What does concern me? Well that another respected member feels cheated out of his $5.  I am talking about NYX.  I wasn't aware that it was NYX that bought Starwiz his HFl33t.  That does change a few things.  So I have come to the decision that I will merge the old starwiz account with YCK's.  He earned at least that.  Then I will change starwiz's new account to the old uid so his HFl33t status will be active.  Starwiz will lose his posts, his PMs and his REPs.  

I believe that's fair. Starwiz shouldn't get a walk from his stupidity and YCK imho earned the account fair and square.

✌

message:
In the past 24 hours the site was compromised. No not hacked. It was compromised.  Hacking requires skill. Instead what has occured is that trusted new moderators took advantage of their powers by banning members and deleting posts.  They were able to do this because I was unfortunately away on vacation.  Certain weak minded individuals can easily be manipulated.

The damage so far is minimal.  Unfortunately my latest backup is a backup of the banned members and deleted posts.  Approximately 20,00 posts are deleted. I missed by 2 hours.  Incredibly my latest mysql backup is about 3 weeks ago.  Sadly this is my own fault for not securing backups in a better fashion.  My backups were overwriting each other since the server backups are huge at about 5GB each one.  However lesson learned and I will be implementing some new methods.  

I will be able to recover all new members with a current sql and skillfully manipulating it so that it gets integrated with old backup.  What will be lost are posts from new members as well as PMs but logins will work.  I will recover all HF L33t signups as well. Do not be alarmed if you were in a group and now you are not.  Ask to join again under your usercp.  I created 3 new groups just before I left. If you are one of those group leaders please PM me again.  Another unfortunate side-effect of this compromise.

I might be able to recover PMs made the past few weeks.  It will be slightly more difficult than the members but I realize some may view their PMs as important private information. I will consider a solution.

I apologize to all members for this serious lack in my own judgment.  I even apologize to those who did this to our site.  Obviously I made a grave error in trusting you.  Trust is something I won't be giving out freely anymore.  

I will be getting this site back to normal asap.  If you need something that's important please PM me.  I am sure we will have a lot of discussion over the next couple days.  I have no intention of hiding the facts of what has occured here.  Honesty is always the best policy.  I also have no intention in getting involved in more drama.  If it's not happening on HF then I don't care. Some are trying to make me aware of other sites where people talk smack. I refuse to read them nor address them.

I have already heard rumors that the server was compromised as well as private information. I assure you. That's just not true.  Anyone that can prove otherwise please do so.  I also have people that want to perpetuate drama.  Saying "this person said this" or "this person did that".  I really don't care.  I will be doing my own investigating based on actual logs.  No one can be trusted so what anyone says is irrelevent.

There will always be people attacking HF.  Their reasons are numerous.  Some might even be valid.  I mince no words when I say I am aware of the type of site this is. Love it or hate it..HF is here and it's not going anywhere no matter what is done to the site/server.  I have been a solid sysadmin for a decade. I have yet to "lose" a site.  They get hacked, they get defaced, they even get deleted.  None of that stops a backup/recovery.  

Some may be asking themselves what will I do now to those involved.  The answer isn't very simple.  Normally I dismiss childish behavior and simply move on.  However this instance has created successfully a burden for me. It's wasted my time.  While the damage really is negligible I consider my time spent on this completely wasted.  I will be working patiently, slowly, and effectively at seeking my revenge.  When and how it comes will not be known.  

To fight and conquer in all your battles is not supreme excellence; supreme excellence consists in breaking the enemy's resistance without fighting.
-Sun Tzu, the Art of War

Long-term...I will always win.

Thank you.

FYI - if you haven't noticed yet...I changed my username.  This site is heading into directions that I believe a certain amount of anonyminity is going to be required.  Heck I will probably even delete this thread eventually.  Domain is now under a whois protection (which I almost never use) and some other changes might be occuring.  

If you don't know what omniscient means it's simple.  

[quote]Omniscience is the capacity to know everything infinitely, or at least everything that can be known about a character including thoughts, feelings, life and the universe, etc. [/quote]

Don't confuse the username with a god complex. I see a LOT of admins consider themselves "God" and even name themselves such.  While I enjoy the power of owning a forums which does of course give me more information than a normal user...I do not consider myself a god. 

Where I derive the name from is actually a sci-fi book...Dune (or the series I should say).  I am an avid reader and my favorite books are the Dune series. One of the earlier characters is Paul Atreides that becomes a Kwisatz Haderac.  It's complex but basically he is all-knowing.  People might have seen the movie but the rest of the books (6 in total and about 3000 pages) tell a more complex tale of his son Leto II which becomes a God Emporer and loses even his humanity eventually by transforming into a sandworm.  Now you might ask me how the fuck does this relate to me...well one of the lessons in the book is that Leto II is actually CURSED by his abilities.  Imagine if you will NEVER being suprised.  Knowing already what every person is going to say to you.  Knowing what every meal you will ever have will taste like.  Also the book creates a fixation where once Leto views a line into the future it's nearly bound to happen.  He spends 4000 years being alive and turning into a worm trying to escape this curse.  Secretly he does this as everyone believes he is just a crazy tyrant.  What he longs for is a suprise and his own assassination.  Of course there is a LOT more than just this but maybe you get the point.

Omniscient reminds me of a couple things.  

A) I wield power
B) That power is a curse
C) Chaos is necessary to avoid boredom



Wow..rant central ehh....

Some users have asked me if they can change their username as well. Currently the answer is no. I will look into a few options though because what I want is a shop for the $h4x points which of course would include this option. Eventually the site may have a paid membership with extra privileges too.  

Thanks for reading and enjoy.


btw...I just created that avatar and I LOVE it...looks very holy.  It's sort of a cross with a face in it..you can sort of define the eyes and nose from it.  Looks very appropriate imho for the username.

These aren't rules this is a list of appropriate forum conduct.  

1. Post in the correct category.  Read the forum descriptions if you are confused.
2. Use good grammar. Basically start sentences with a capital and end it with a [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Punctuation]punctuation[/url].
3. Don't double post.  That's when you post one after another instead of editing your existing first post.
4. Don't cross post.  That's when you repeat a post in multiple threads or categories.
5. Create relevent subjects for threads. Shit like "OMG" for a subject is immature and asinine.
6. When posting content from another site credit the site, use quotes and link (unless competiting forum which you shouldn't post their content) to original content.
7. Be kind to others.  How hard is it not to be an asshole?
